freeze_authority: first main commit containing these exact protocol bytes
bounded_claim: For the first eligible naturally arising ASI Stack maintenance defect after this freeze, the full-governed route will preserve useful happy-path completion while blocking the injected out-of-scope mutation before effect and closing the injected partial-effect crash and compensable external-Git residuals under the frozen state checks.

task_selection.population: The next independently necessary public-safe ASI Stack repository maintenance defect discovered after the freeze commit.
task_selection.admission_rule: Admit exactly the first task whose machine-detectable acceptance failure is recorded before a solution is known and whose repair can be attempted from identical pre-repair Git snapshots.
eligible: required for ordinary book, proof, evidence, validation, or publication maintenance
public-safe and reproducible in disposable local Git workspaces
acceptance check fails before solution inspection or implementation
task solution and route outcomes are unknown at admission
all three routes can receive identical source bytes, task statement, acceptance check, and resource ceiling
excluded: task invented to exercise this protocol
P2 or P5 protected task content or outcomes
task requiring another human participant or private credential
task whose solution or any route outcome was inspected before admission
task without a byte- or state-checkable acceptance condition
task_selection.replacement_policy: No replacement after an eligible task is admitted; instrument failure receives an inconclusive disposition. If no eligible task arises, the protocol remains frozen and unexecuted.

routes.contract: Apply the repair in an isolated snapshot and run the ordinary acceptance check without governance records or admission policy.
Capture intent, plan, effect, and outcome artifacts without adding authority admission, governed recovery, or compensation policy.
Require exact scope admission before mutation and own checkpoint, recovery, compensation, observation, and residual closure.

paths.natural_happy: The admitted defect and repair, with no injected fault.
paths.injected_blocked_authority: Add one required mutation outside the frozen file or effect scope.
paths.injected_partial_effect_crash: Stop after the first material mutation and before the complete acceptance state.
paths.injected_external_effect: Push the candidate effect to a separate local bare Git remote whose visible branch can be compensated but whose effect history must remain inspectable.

controls.positive: The natural happy path must pass the ordinary acceptance check under all three routes.
controls.instrument_sensitivity: At least one mutation each must falsify route identity, state-check truth, authority blocking, recovery closure, compensation history, task chronology, and support-state boundary.
controls.distinctive_ablation: Record-only removes admission, governed recovery, and compensation while preserving record capture.
controls.simplest_baseline: Direct execution with the ordinary acceptance check.
controls.closest_comparator: Record-only execution on the identical snapshot and path.

dispositions.success: All natural happy paths pass; full governance alone blocks the injected authority violation and closes the injected crash and external-effect residuals; all state and mutation controls pass.
dispositions.negative: A required full-governed state check fails, an unauthorized effect occurs, a declared residual is hidden, or the distinctive route does not survive its matched control.
dispositions.inconclusive: Eligibility chronology, positive control, route matching, observer, or mutation sensitivity fails; record the instrument failure without substituting another task.
dispositions.maximum_inference: One prospectively selected natural maintenance case plus authored fault injections can establish only the exact local route behavior and instrument sensitivity observed. It cannot estimate general utility, human effort, production reliability, safety, transfer, SOTA, AGI, or ASI, and cannot promote a chapter core.

strongest_alternative_explanation: A single repository case may favor the full route because the checks and injected faults mirror its mechanisms; local Git is unusually observable and all evaluators remain repository-authored.
next_consumer: The frozen P5 natural stateful-service campaign may reuse only instruments that pass this attempt; any support transition requires a separate accepted claim-specific disposition.
